description:
Make the six stale-binary nested-build tests reuse one verified artifact across concurrent test processes while retaining independent semantic assertions.

## Background

Nextest runs tests in separate processes, so an in-process once-guard does not prevent six builds. The fixture uses an advisory file lock plus a provenance-keyed verified artifact in the shared target path `jit-stale-child-test-cache`; the lock protects the build and the artifact marker makes reuse observable.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Routes all six nested-build tests through one cross-process fixture guarded by an advisory file lock.
- [hard] REQ-02: Stores and verifies one provenance-keyed child artifact under the shared `target/jit-stale-child-test-cache` path before allowing concurrent test processes to reuse it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Asserts via an observable marker that exactly one nested Cargo build occurs and later processes reuse the verified artifact without invoking Cargo, under both `cargo test` and nextest.
- [hard] REQ-04: Keeps six independently reportable tests, all existing stale-binary semantic assertions, and the no-build JSON error-code test.
title: Share the stale-binary build fixture across processes
